response.sql: WITH acc AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), diff AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM acc) AS diff_from_avg FROM acc), reg AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff_from_avg, AVG(diff_from_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg_diff FROM diff) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff_from_avg, diff_from_avg - region_avg_diff AS excess_over_region_avg FROM reg WHERE diff_from_avg > region_avg_diff ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg DESC LIMIT 10
